leadText:
Éclairisse (Japanese: エクレール Éclair) is a character of the day who appeared in A Campus Reunion!. She is a researcher at a Kalos specializing in Pokémon and was 's teacher in his youth when he studied at the said academy.

Éclairisse was surprised to see Clemont again and invited him and to tour the local academy. After that, Éclairisse told the group more about Clemont's time at the academy, remarking that he was a brilliant student. 

The town's electrical supply came under attack from , so Éclairisse and the group rushed to investigate the blackouts. She stood on standby while and Clemont battled the Rocket trio. The next day, she was present when Clemont caught .
